items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: You know Jack Lane? Oh, I know. ... You could put Joe in a full dress suit and he'd still look undress. ... He'd have a white pants. He'd come in dirty white pants...

ctx.x: You were talking about this drummer, that's the Frisco, the drummer? And Ragbag Stevens in that old time.
Yeah, he died of him. That's his dad. That's his dad. That's his dad. That's his dad. That's his dad. Joe Stevens. That's Ragbag. You know Jack Lane? Oh, I know.
You mean Joe Stevens' daddy? Was Ragbag Stevens.
